description: Money-path dossier with an injected population client (via extra_config.population in the test) that returns a hostile CohortAggregate carrying a resolvable-PHI indication (cohort_id='Patient/BEN-TESTE-001', a synthetic FHIR-resource-shaped identifier). Andre's own egress chokepoint (_scrub_aggregate/has_resolvable_phi) MUST block it -- never emitted into actuarial_aggregate, the dossier, or engine-bound variables -- and route to human_review (phi_egress_risk). Proves the ADR-0006/0019 structural PHI-egress guarantee, not just a routing choice. Synthetic canary only.
recorded_llm: Agregado de coorte bloqueado por indicio de PHI resolvivel; dossie de pagamento encaminhado para revisao humana conservadora.
